blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large image-to-3D generators recover detailed heads from a single photograph but treat every image as a new object. For several images of one person, they hallucinate unseen regions independently without using information from the other images. We present Head Anything, which generates detailed head meshes from a few images with changing expressions and viewpoints. Instead of training a multi-image prior, we turn a pretrained single-image generator with a native 3D latent space into a joint generator that denoises all images together. Since global attention between images is hard to learn from scarce 3D head data, lightweight correspondence-attention adapters let every 3D token attend only to its corresponding points in the other images. We obtain correspondences by fitting a neural parametric head model to the generator's own single-image outputs, requiring no ground truth at test time. Training on both ground-truth and fitted correspondences makes the adapters robust to fitting errors. Each mesh stays pixel-aligned with its own image and borrows the unseen regions from all others. On head scans, Head Anything lowers the head Chamfer distance of the best image-to-3D generator by 32% and its cross-frame inconsistency by 47%, and its meshes improve face tracking. Code and models will be released.
blocks.zh: 大型的图像到-3D生成器从一张照片中回收详细的头,但把每个图像都当作一个新的物体. 对于一个人的几个图像来说,他们不使用其他图像的信息,就独立地幻觉了看不见的区域. 我们呈现“头什么”,它从几个画面中产生详细的头部,并带有变化的表达和观点。 而不是训练一个多图像前, 我们把一个预先训练的 单图像生成器 与本地的 3D 潜伏空间 变成一个联合生成器, 将所有图像都一起隐藏。 由于图像之间的全球关注很难从稀缺的3D头数据中学习,所以轻量级的函授-注意适配器让每个3D令牌只注意其在其他图像中的相应点. 我们通过安装一个神经参数头模型 来获取通信 用于生成器的单像输出 关于地面真相和装配通信的培训使适配器能够很好地适应错误。 每个网格保持像素与自己的图像相匹配,并向所有其他区域借阅看不见的区域。 在头部扫描中,"头任何东西"将最佳图像到3D生成器的头部Chamfer距离降低32%,其跨帧不一致度降低47%,它的网格改善了面部跟踪. 将发布代码和模型。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Telepresence, games, film production and virtual try-on need the 3D geometry of a person’s head, including the hair, the ears and the back of the head, at a level of detail that today requires a multi-view capture studio [ 17 , 26 ] .
Most images of people, however, come from casual videos or photo collections, such as those in Fig. 1 , and depict the head from varying viewpoints and with different expressions.
Recovering complete, detailed and mutually consistent meshes from such images would make studio-quality head geometry available from everyday data, with every mesh following its own image and benefiting from what the others reveal.
blocks.zh:
Telepresence,游戏,电影制作和虚拟试播需要一个人的头部的3D几何,包括头发,耳朵和头部的后部,其详细程度今天需要多景捕捉工作室[17,26].
然而,人们的大多数图像来自临时视频或照片集,如图1中的图片,并用不同的观点和不同的表达来描绘头部。
从这些图像中恢复完整、详细和相互一致的网格将使工作室质量的头几何从日常数据中获得,每个网格都遵循自己的图像,并受益于其他人所揭示的内容。

blocks.en:
This problem is underconstrained.
Each image shows only part of the head, and since expression and pose change, multi-view reconstruction does not apply.
A strong learned prior is indispensable, but high-quality head scans exist for only a few hundred people [ 11 , 39 ] , far fewer than the hundreds of thousands of objects used to train general image-to-3D generators [ 8 ] .
A prior over multiple images is even harder to learn, since the same point on the head appears at a different position in each image as expressions and poses change, and global attention across images cannot reliably learn these correspondences from so few identities.
blocks.zh:
这个问题没有受到足够的限制。
每个图像只显示部分头部,由于表达和姿势变化,多视图重建不适用.
强健的先学是不可或缺的,但只有几百人有高质量的头部扫描[11,39],远远少于用来训练一般图像到3D发电机的数十万物体[8].
以前超过多个图像更难学习,因为头部的同一点作为表达方式出现在每个图像的不同位置上,并带来变化,全球对图像的关注无法可靠地从如此少的身份中学习这些对应.

blocks.en:
Existing methods work around this lack of 3D data with different trade-offs.
Parametric head models [ 3 , 21 , 11 ] and their trackers [ 49 , 28 , 13 , 12 ] naturally combine many frames, but their geometry is coarse and misses hair and fine detail.
Feed-forward methods predict per-pixel geometry and correspondences [ 19 ] , but only for the visible surface.
Large image-to-3D generators [ 42 , 43 , 22 , 36 , 41 , 20 ] produce complete, detailed meshes, but from one image at a time, and their multi-image variants assume a static object.
Video and multi-view diffusion models share information along optical flow [ 7 , 10 ] , epipolar lines [ 37 , 15 ] or a morphable head model [ 6 , 35 ] , but only between 2D images.
blocks.zh:
现有方法围绕缺乏具有不同权衡的三维数据。
参数头型号[3,21,11]及其跟踪器[49,28,13,12]自然结合了许多帧,但是它们的几何结构粗糙,缺少头发和细细的细节.
Feed-forward方法预测每像素几何和对应[19],但只针对可见的表面.
大型图像到3D发电机[42,43,22,36,41,20]产生完整,详细的元件,但一次从一个图像中产生,其多图像变体假设一个静态物体.
视频和多视图传播模型沿光学流[7,10],极线[37,15]或可形态头型模型[6,35]共享信息,但仅在2D图像之间.

blocks.en:
We introduce Head Anything for multi-image 3D head generation by adapting a pretrained single-image generator with a native 3D latent space to jointly generate 3D heads from multiple images of the same person.
As Fig. 2 shows, it jointly denoises all 3D latents using lightweight adapters letting each 3D token attend only to corresponding points in the other images.
Unlike global attention, correspondence attention knows where to look from the first training step.
The correspondences are deformable and bootstrapped from the generator itself by fitting a neural parametric head model [ 11 , 12 ] to its single-image outputs.
This eliminates ground-truth requirements at test time, while training on both ground-truth and fitted correspondences makes the adapters robust to fitting errors.
Routing attention through these correspondences within a 3D latent generator distinguishes our method from image-space correspondence attention and from simply combining a generator with a parametric fit.
Experiments show our meshes are more accurate than all baselines, far more consistent across frames than image-to-3D generators’ meshes, and improve a parametric face tracker’s performance.
Joint generation yields greater accuracy and consistency than frame-by-frame generation using our backbone, Pixal3D [ 20 ] , fine-tuned on head scans.
blocks.zh:
我们为多图像的3D头生成引入了Head Anything,方法是在本地的3D潜伏空间中改造一个预先训练过的单图像生成器,从同一人的多个图像中联合生成3D头.
如图2所示,它使用轻量级适配器将所有3D潜伏物共同剥离,使每个3D令牌只注意其他图像中的相应点.
与全球关注不同,函授关注知道从培训的第一步看哪里。
通信可变形,通过将神经参数化头型[11,12]安装到其单像输出上,从发电机本身中脱落。
这消除了试验时对地面真实性的要求,而地面真实性培训和装配的通信则使适配器能够适应错误。
在3D潜在生成器内通过这些函证运行注意力,将我们的方法与图像空间的函证注意力区分开来,也不简单地将一个生成器与一个参数匹配器结合起来.
实验显示我们的网格比所有的基线更准确,跨帧比图像到3D发电机的网格更一致,并改进一个参数面跟踪器的性能。
利用我们的骨干Pixal3D[20],在头部扫描上进行微调,联合生成产生的精度和一致性比逐帧生成更强.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • We introduce a joint multi-image head generator that couples the sampling processes of a pretrained single-image 3D generator, so that every mesh follows its own image and benefits from all others. • We propose a novel correspondence attention mechanism in which every 3D token attends to its corresponding points in the other images, given by a neural parametric head model fitted to the generator’s own outputs and made robust by mixed ground-truth and fitted correspondences. • We demonstrate that joint generation produces more accurate 3D heads than all baselines, far more consistent unseen regions than image-to-3D generators, and meshes that improve parametric face tracking.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的贡献是: 我们采用联合多图像头生成器,将预先训练的单图像3D生成器的取样过程对齐,这样,每个网格都遵循自己的图像,并从所有其他方面获益。 我们提出了一个新的函证注意机制,每个3D信使都注意其他图像中的相应点,这种信使是安装在发电机自身输出器上的神经参数头型,通过混合的地面真象和装配的函证来坚固的。 我们证明,联合生成比所有基线更精确的三维头,比图像到三维发电机更一致的看不见区域,以及改进参数面跟踪的网格。

blocks.en: We introduce a joint multi-image head generator that couples the sampling processes of a pretrained single-image 3D generator, so that every mesh follows its own image and benefits from all others.

blocks.en:
3D generators trained on object collections [ 8 ] either lift novel-view and multi-view diffusion models to 3D [ 24 , 33 ] or generate directly in native 3D latent spaces.
TRELLIS [ 42 ] denoises a sparse voxel structure and then structured latents on the occupied voxels.
TRELLIS.2 [ 43 ] makes these latents compact at high resolution.
TripoSG [ 22 ] and Hunyuan3D-2.1 [ 36 ] use rectified flows [ 25 , 23 ] over vector-set latents, and Direct3D-S2 [ 41 ] scales sparse attention to high-resolution volumes.
Pixal3D [ 20 ] back-projects image features into the voxel grid, so that the generated geometry is aligned with the input pixels and preserves fine details.
All of these methods generate one object from one image, and their multi-image modes assume one rigid object.
blocks.zh:
接受过对象集培训的3D生成器 [8] 要么将小说视图和多视图传播模型提升到3D [24,33],要么直接在本地3D潜在空间中生成.
TRELLIS[42] 凹陷一个稀疏的阴道结构,然后结构化的潜伏在占用的阴道上.
TRELLIS.2 [43] 使这些潜质在高分辨率下变得紧凑.
TripoSG [22] 和Hunyuan3D-2.1 [36] 使用修正流[25,23] 超过矢量设定潜伏,以及Direct3D-S2 [41] 缩放对高分辨率量的关注很少。
Pixal3D [20] 后工程的图像特征进入voxel网格,这样生成的几何与输入像素一致,并保存精细的细节.
所有这些方法都从一个图像中产生一个对象,它们的多图像模式假设一个刚性对象.

blocks.en:
Morphable models [ 3 ] such as FLAME [ 21 ] form the basis of most monocular face reconstruction and tracking methods [ 9 , 49 , 28 , 13 ] .
They provide a consistent topology, but their geometry is coarse and covers neither hair nor accessories.
NPHM [ 11 ] models identity and expression of complete heads with neural fields learned from scans, and MonoNPHM [ 12 ] adds appearance and fits it to monocular videos, with detail bounded by its latent space.
Feed-forward methods regress per-frame geometry and correspondences from images [ 19 ] , but only for the visible surface.
Capture setups [ 17 , 26 ] and the avatars built on them [ 29 ] need calibrated camera rigs.
We use a parametric head model only as a source of dense correspondences, while the geometry comes from the generator.
blocks.zh:
可溶性模型[3],如FLAME[21],构成了大多数单面重建与跟踪方法的基础[9,49,28,13].
它们提供一致的地形,但其几何结构粗糙,既不覆盖毛发,也不覆盖配件.
NPHM [11] 模型识别和表达完整的头部,从扫描中学习到神经领域,而MonoNPHM [12] 增加了外观并适合单视,细节以其潜伏空间为界.
Feed-forward方法从图像中反射每帧几何和对应[19],但只针对可见的表面.
捕捉装置 [17,26] 和建在他们的浮雕 [29] 需要校准的相机钻机。
我们只使用一个参数头模型作为稠密通信的来源,而几何学则来自生成器.

blocks.en:
Video diffusion models attend between frames at the same spatial location [ 4 , 40 ] , while video editing methods follow correspondences.
FLATTEN restricts attention to patches on the same optical-flow path [ 7 ] , and TokenFlow propagates diffusion features through nearest-neighbour correspondences [ 10 ] .
Multi-view diffusion models attend along epipolar lines [ 37 , 15 ] , and for heads, Morphable Diffusion [ 6 ] and CAP4D [ 35 ] condition multi-view diffusion on a morphable model and reconstruct an avatar from the generated views.
4D methods reconstruct dynamic objects from video [ 14 , 45 , 30 ] or animate one generated mesh [ 5 ] , and training-free approaches average several diffusion processes where they overlap [ 1 , 16 ] .
All correspondence-guided methods above exchange information between 2D images, with correspondences from optical flow, camera geometry or a rendered morphable model, and obtain 3D only through a separate reconstruction.
We instead exchange information between sparse tokens within a native 3D latent generator.
Deformable correspondences bootstrapped from the generator’s single-image outputs connect tokens across different head poses and expressions.
Each frame retains its own detailed mesh.
As in ControlNet [ 46 ] , the adapters are zero-initialised modules on a pretrained backbone, which keeps its prior intact at the start of training.
blocks.zh:
视频传播模型出现在相同空间位置的帧之间[4,40],而视频编辑方法遵循通信.
FLATTEN将注意力限制在相同光学流道上的补丁[7],TokenFlow通过近邻通信传播扩散特征[10].
多视传播模型沿着极地线[37,15]参加,对于头部,可解变扩散[6]和CAP4D[35]条件多视传播在可解变模型上进行,并从生成的视角重建一个异形.
4D方法从视频[14,45,30]或动画1中重建动态物体生成网格[5],无训练方法平均在重叠的几个扩散过程[1,16].
所有上面的通信制导方法在2D图像之间交换信息,有光学流,相机几何或变形模型的通信,只能通过单独的重建获得3D.
相反,我们在一个本地的3D潜在生成器中 在稀有的信号之间交换信息。
从生成器的单一图像输出中脱落的可变形函式将不同头部的符号和表达式连接起来。
每个帧保留了自己的详细网格.
与ControlNet [46] 一样,适配器是预训主干线上的零初始化模块,在培训开始时保持其先前完好无损.

blocks.en: 3.2 A Single-Image Head Prior
blocks.zh: 3.2 单图像头前身

blocks.en:
Object-level generators miss the specific shape of a face and often fail on hair, so we fine-tune Pixal3D on photorealistic renders of the NPHM head scans [ 11 ] .
The resulting Pixal3D-FT is a strong single-image head prior, but it generates every frame on its own, so the frames do not benefit from each other. It also hallucinates the back of the head and the hair independently for every frame.
blocks.zh:
对象级发电机错过了一张面部的特定形状,经常在头发上失效,因此我们微调了NPHM头部扫描的光现实化成的Pixal3D. [11].
由此产生的Pixal3D-FT是一个强力的单像头前部,但它会自行生成每个帧,因此帧并不相互受益. 它还对每帧头部和头发的背部独立产生幻觉.

blocks.en: 3.3 Joint Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 联合发电

blocks.en:
Instead of n n independent samples, our method draws the latents of all frames as one sample from their joint distribution given all images { I f } f = 1 n \{I_{f}\}_{f=1}^{n} .
Each frame keeps its own noise, condition c f c_{f} , tokens and, in S2, occupied voxels, so that every mesh stays aligned with its own image.

blocks.en:
Different frames observe different regions of the head, so the tokens of a region that one image does not show can take their shape from the frames that do.
Since the head turns and the face deforms between frames, the same voxel holds different points of the head in different frames, and a token can only profit from another frame if it knows where its corresponding point lies.
Global attention to all tokens of other frames would have to learn from a few hundred identities where to attend among tens of thousands of tokens, which it cannot do reliably ( Sec. 4.4 ).
We thus restrict attention to corresponding positions, as Fig. 3 illustrates, so the adapters only learn what to take from each frame.

blocks.en:
A training group consists of scans of one identity with different expressions, each rendered from its own random viewpoint, and Eq. 1 is summed over the group.
The two instances of Eq. 3 differ in kind, since registration maps are exact on the scan surface and interpolate elsewhere, whereas fitted maps follow the learned deformation field of MonoNPHM everywhere but inherit the errors of the fit.
Adapters trained on registrations alone therefore never see the kind of correspondences that they receive at test time.
We run this procedure once to precompute fitted correspondences for a fixed pool of training groups.
During training, half the groups come from this pool, while the other half use registration correspondences.
Fitted correspondences expose adapters to fitting errors, while registration groups provide accurate supervision.
Changing group size from 2 to 8 scans lets one model handle varying numbers of images.
At test time, our method first generates per-frame meshes for fitting, then jointly generates all meshes of a person.
A modified version of the standard clean-up avoids introducing holes.

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details

blocks.en:
For Pixal3D-FT, we fine-tune Pixal3D on 10,180 scans of the 477 NPHM identities outside our test set, each rendered from two viewpoints. S1, S2 and the cascade are trained for 8k, 8k and 12k steps, respectively, with learning rates of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , 10 − 5 10^{-5} and 5 ⋅ 10 − 6 5{\cdot}10^{-6} and batch sizes of 16, 16 and 4.
For joint generation, the adapters follow every third block of both flows, with width 512, 8 heads and K = 4 K{=}4 keys per frame in S2, which amounts to 55 M parameters per stage.
We train them with the backbone on groups of 2 to 8 scans from the 459 of these 477 identities with at least four scans.
Each stage is trained for 4k steps with two groups per step in S1 and one in S2 and learning rates of 10 − 4 10^{-4} for the adapters and 10 − 5 10^{-5} for the backbone.
Both trainings use AdamW, 200 warm-up steps and a condition dropout of 0.1 for classifier-free guidance.
On NVIDIA A100 GPUs, the fine-tuning uses two GPUs per stage, and the adapter training takes about 7 h for S1 and 6 h for S2 on one GPU.
For eight images, our method takes about 2.3 times as long as generating them one by one with Pixal3D-FT.

Each person’s eight input images show four expressions captured by two synchronised cameras, one on each side of the face. The remaining cameras provide held-out views and multi-view stereo points from COLMAP [ 31 , 32 ] .
Video frames from VFHQ [ 44 ] and CelebV-HQ [ 48 ] serve for qualitative results, and all methods receive the same RGBA crops.

我们评估了NPHM训练和测试组之外的10个NERSemble[17]个身份和10个AVA-256[26]个身份。
每个人的8个输入图像显示两个同步摄像头捕捉到的4个表情,每面各一个. 其余的摄像头提供来自COLMAP[31,32]的被搁置的观点和多视图立体点.
来自VFHQ[44]和CelebV-HQ[48]的视频帧可以提供质量结果,所有方法都得到相同的RGBA作物.

blocks.en:
We compare against the parametric trackers VHAP [ 28 ] and Pixel3DMM [ 13 ] , which fit a shared identity across a person’s images.
We also evaluate MonoNPHM [ 12 ] and six image-to-3D generators [ 42 , 41 , 43 , 22 , 36 , 20 ] on each image independently.
Finally, Pixal3D-FT uses our fine-tuned backbone to generate a mesh independently for each image.
Our method and Pixal3D-FT use only the input camera, as described in Sec. 3.5 .
Ground-truth geometry and all other cameras are used only for evaluation.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了参数跟踪仪 VHAP [28] 和像素3DMM [13],它们符合个人图像上的共同身份。
我们还对每个图像进行MonoNPHM[12]和6个图像对3D发电机[42、41、43、22、36、20]的独立评估。
最后,Pixal3D-FT使用我们微调的骨干为每个图像独立生成网格.
如第3.5节所述,我们的方法和Pixal3D-FT只使用输入相机。
地面真实几何和所有其他相机仅用于评价。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Back-of-head consistency on NeRSemble. Side views of the meshes generated from four input frames. Pixal3D-FT hallucinates a different hairstyle for every frame, while ours agree.
blocks.zh: 图6 NERSemble上的后头一致性. 四个输入框生成的网格的侧视图 。 Pixal3D -FT 幻觉 一种不同的发型 每帧, 而我们的同意。

blocks.en:
Every prediction, ours included, is aligned to its scan with the same similarity search [ 2 , 38 ] and a final rigid face alignment, so that the metrics compare shapes rather than placements.
In the head region above a plane 2 cm below the chin, we report the Chamfer distance, the completeness, the Earth Mover’s distance and the F-score at 2 mm [ 18 ] .
We warp each aligned prediction’s non-face surface into every other frame using ground-truth deformation.
Cross-frame consistency measures the mean distance to the target predictions.
For the captures, we report silhouette IoU in held-out cameras after a similarity fit using the alignment cameras.
We also report the Chamfer distance between the camera-visible head and stereo points.
We measure consistency by the head Chamfer distance between meshes generated from synchronised images of the same instant.
All distances are in mm and F-scores in %.

包括我们的预测在内,每一个预测都与它的扫描一致,与相同的相似性搜索[2,38]和最后的僵硬的面部对齐,这样,度量表就可以比较形状而不是位置.
在下巴下方2厘米的平面上方,我们报告Chamfer距离、完整性、地球移动器距离和F分数为2毫米[18]。
我们利用地面真实变形,将每个预测的非面面面对准到所有其他框架。
跨框架一致性测量与目标预测的平均距离.
对于捕捉,我们报告Silhouette IoU在使用对齐摄像头的相似性后,被搁置的摄像头。
我们还报告相机可见头部和立体点之间的Chamfer距离。
我们用来自同一瞬间同步图像的 中间线之间 的相距来测量一致性
所有距离为毫米,F分数为%.

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with the State of the Art
blocks.zh: 4.3 与艺术状况的比较

blocks.en:
Fig. 4 compares meshes for frames of NeRSemble, AVA-256, VFHQ and CelebV-HQ.
The parametric models recover plausible faces but represent hair as a smooth volume at best, while image-to-3D generators often fail to capture specific facial shape and produce noisy hair geometry.
Our meshes have a higher surface quality and more detail, both in facial features such as the eyes, lips and wrinkles and in the structure of the hair.
blocks.zh:
图4比较了NeRSemble、AVA-256、VFHQ和CelebV-HQ的帧。
参数模型恢复了假面貌,但最多只能代表毛发的光滑体积,而图像到3D的生成器往往无法捕捉到特定的面部形状,产生吵闹的毛发几何.
我们的米壳表面质量更高,细节更详细,无论是在眼睛,唇和皱纹等面部特征上,还是在头发的结构上.

blocks.en:
Tab. 1 evaluates all methods against the ground-truth scans.
Our method is the most accurate on both datasets, including FaceVerse, whose scans and inputs differ from our training data, whereas the parametric models produce coarse heads without hair.
Their shared template makes them consistent by construction, which is why we do not rank them in consistency.
Fine-tuning on head scans already makes Pixal3D-FT the strongest generator, and joint generation improves over it in accuracy and clearly in cross-frame consistency, although both share one backbone.
The error maps in Fig. 5 confirm that our meshes are closer to the scans across the whole head.
blocks.zh:
标签1根据地面真实扫描来评价所有方法.
我们的方法是两个数据集中最准确的方法,包括FaceVerse,其扫描和输入与我们的训练数据不同,而参数模型则产生粗糙的无毛头.
它们的共享模板使得它们通过构建而保持一致,这就是为什么我们没有在一致性上排列它们.
对头部扫描的微调已经使Pixal3D-FT成为了最强的生成器,联合生成器在准确度和跨帧一致性上明显提高,虽然两者都有一个主干.
Fig. 5的误差图证实 我们的网格更接近整个头部的扫描

As Tab. 2 shows, our method outperforms all baselines on the real images of NeRSemble and AVA-256.
Our method produces more accurate held-out silhouettes, indicating better reconstruction of unseen regions.
Its visible head surfaces are closer to the stereo points, and meshes from synchronised cameras agree more closely than those of every other generator.
Joint generation improves all three metrics over Pixal3D-FT, which shares our backbone, on both datasets.
blocks.zh:
正如Tab. 2所示,我们的方法在NERSemble和AVA-256的真实图像上超过了所有基线。
我们的方法产生了更准确的屏蔽,表明对看不见的区域进行了更好的重建。
其明显的头面表面更接近立体点,同步摄像头的元件比其他所有发电机的元件更接近一致.
联合生成比Pixal3D-FT改进了所有三个度量衡,在两个数据集上共享我们的骨干.

Fig. 6 shows the back of the head, which none of the inputs shows.
Pixal3D-FT hallucinates a different hairstyle when generating each frame independently, whereas our meshes, denoised jointly and coupled at corresponding points, share one hairstyle.
blocks.zh:
图6显示了头部的后部,没有输入显示这一点.
Pixal3D-FT在独立生成每个帧时会产生不同的发型,而我们的网格,在相应的点点上联合和组合,共享一个发型.

blocks.en: Table 3 : FLAME tracking accuracy on AVA-256. Each “+” row adds a 3D term towards a per-frame prediction to the Pixel3DMM fit.
blocks.zh: 表3:AVA-256上的FLAME跟踪精度. 每个“+”行在像素3DMM装置上增加一个3D术语,用于对每帧的预测。

blocks.en:
Our meshes can also constrain a tracker.
On frontal-camera AVA-256 images, we refine Pixel3DMM’s [ 13 ] multi-image FLAME fit with a robust point-to-surface term using our meshes or Face Anything’s [ 19 ] per-pixel geometry.
Both use identical placement and weighting, without ground truth.
As Tab. 3 shows, both constraints improve the tracker, and our meshes, which cover the whole head, improve it most.
blocks.zh:
我们的网格也可以限制追踪器
在前摄像头AVA-256影像上, 我们用我们的网格或Face Anything's [19] 每个像素几何来精炼Pixel3DMM的多图像FLAME,
两者都使用相同的位置和权重,没有根据的真理.
Tab. 3显示, 两种限制都改善了追踪器, 而我们覆盖整个头部的网格, 改进最多。

blocks.zh: 图7:图像数量。 目标框架的首区度量衡与1,2,4或8个图像共同生成.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en:
Tab. 4 evaluates the ablations on NPHM with the metrics of Tab. 1 . Each variant changes one component and uses the same test-time fits.
Synchronising Pixal3D-FT without training, by averaging the predicted occupancy of corresponding voxels at every step [ 1 , 16 ] , forces the frames to agree and yields the best consistency. However, consistency measures agreement rather than fidelity. Averaging erodes the heads and yields the largest errors, supporting learned cross-frame information exchange.
Global attention over all tokens of other frames is clearly less accurate, as it does not learn where to attend from a few hundred identities.
We test the correspondence map against the GT-only variant, trained on ground-truth correspondences only, whose adapters never see the noisy fitted correspondences of test time.
Same-voxel attention, as in video models, attends to the same voxel in the other frames and falls clearly behind, since that voxel holds a different point of the head.
FLAME correspondences attend to the points that fitted FLAME surfaces match; the more accurate NPHM correspondences of the GT-only variant generate better heads, with lower errors and a clearly higher F-score.
Finally, mixing in fitted correspondences, which teaches the adapters to cope with their errors, improves every metric over the GT-only variant.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 4用Tab的衡量标准来评价NPHM上的浮标。 1,每个变体改变一个组件,并使用相同的试验时间。
同步 Pixal3D-FT 不经过培训,通过在每一步[1,16]中平均预测相应阴道的占用,迫使帧商定并产生最佳的一致性. 然而,一致性衡量协议而不是忠诚。 夸张会侵蚀头部,产生最大的错误,支持学到的跨框架信息交流。
全球对其他框架的所有标志的关注显然不太准确,因为从几百个身份中它不知道应在哪里参与。
我们用只用GT的变体来测试函证地图,只用地面真实的函证来训练,其适配器从未看到测试时间中装有噪音的函证.
同声波的注意,就像在视频模型中一样,关注其他帧中的同声波,并明显落在后面,因为该声波占据了头部的不同点.
FLAME函证注意安装FLAME表面匹配的点;更精确的NPHM函证只使用GT的变体产生更好的头,错误较低,F分数明显较高.
最后,在装配的函文中混合,使适配器能够应对错误,从而改进了每个度量器,而不是只使用GT的变体。

blocks.zh: 表4:读取研究。 每个变体都会改变它与之相比的行的一个组件;将所有组件组合在一起的完整模型在每一个精度度度量中都是最好的.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
Despite its strong performance, our method is specialised for human heads because it derives correspondences from a parametric head model.
It therefore does not directly generalise to full human bodies or generic objects.
Extending correspondence-routed joint generation to these settings, for example through body models or category-level correspondences, is a promising direction.
The underlying parametric fit becomes less reliable under heavy occlusion or when only a small portion of the face is visible.
Our method also assumes that head geometry remains consistent across images, apart from expression changes.
Photo collections taken at different times, with changes in hairstyle or accessories, therefore fall outside its scope.
Finally, its reliance on a computationally expensive diffusion-based image-to-mesh generator makes real-time applications infeasible.
blocks.zh:
尽管它的强效性能,我们的方法是专用于人类头部的,因为它来源于一个参数头部模型的通信.
因此,它并不直接泛指完整的人体或普通物体。
通过机构模型或类别级的函证等将函证路由联合生成扩展到这些设置,是一个很有希望的方向.
基础的参数合体在重隐蔽或只有一小部分面部可见的情况下变得不那么可靠.
我们的方法还假设,除表达式变化外,头几何在图像之间仍然一致。
在不同时间拍摄的图片集,带有发型或配件的变化,因此不属于其范围.
最后,它依赖一个计算成本昂贵的传播成像到成像生成器,使得实时应用不可行.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Head Anything turns a pretrained single-image 3D generator into a consistent joint generator for any number of images of a person.
Each 3D token attends to corresponding points in other frames.
We obtain these correspondences by fitting a parametric head model to the generator’s outputs, requiring no ground truth at test time.
Training on both ground-truth and fitted correspondences makes the adapters robust to fitting errors.
Each mesh follows its own image, while regions unseen in that image are completed using information from all images.
On scan benchmarks and real captures, Head Anything improves accuracy over generator and parametric baselines.
It also improves consistency over image-to-3D generators, while its meshes improve parametric face tracking.
More broadly, correspondence-routed attention lets a single-image 3D generator exploit several images without training a multi-image prior from scratch.
blocks.zh:
头 任何事物都会将预先训练的单像3D生成器变成一致的联动生成器,用于任何个人的图像数量.
每个3D令牌都注意其他框架的相应点.
我们通过在发电机的输出中安装一个参数头模型来获取这些通信,在测试时不需要任何基本事实。
关于地面真相和装配通信的培训使适配器能够很好地适应错误。
每个网格都遵循自己的图像,而图像中看不见的区域则利用所有图像中的信息完成.
在扫描基准和实际捕捉上,“万事通”提高了发电机和参数基线的准确性。
它还提高了图像到3D生成器的一致性,而它的元件则改善了参数面跟踪.
更广义地说,函授式的注意让一个单图像的3D生成器从零开始就利用几个图像而不训练多图像.

blocks.en: Appendix C Additional Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 其他执行细节

blocks.en: C.1 Base Model and Sampling
blocks.zh: C.1 基准模型和取样

blocks.en:
We build on the public code and the released weights of Pixal3D [ 20 ] , which follows the two-stage design of TRELLIS.2 [ 43 ] with DINOv3 [ 34 ] conditioning, and sample all stages with its released sampler settings.
The noise of every stage is seeded per frame, so a frame receives the same noise in the single-image pass and in every joint group.
The cascade from resolution 512 3 512^{3} to 1024 3 1024^{3} and the decoding run per frame on the jointly generated S2 latent.
blocks.zh:
我们以公用代码和释放重量Pixal3D[20]为基础,遵循TRELLIS.2[43]与DINOv3[34]调制的两阶段设计,并用其释放的采样器设置对所有阶段进行抽样.
每个舞台的噪音都是每个帧的种子,因此一个帧在单像传及每个联组中都得到相同的噪音.
从第512 3 512^{3}至第1024 3 1024^{3} 和联合生成的 S2 潜伏的每个帧的解码运行。

blocks.en: C.2 Single-Image Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: C.2 单一图像精细图解

blocks.en:
Pixal3D-FT is Pixal3D fine-tuned in all three geometry stages with Eq. 1 and no architectural change.
It is fine-tuned on renders of the scans, and our adapters are trained on the same renders.
We rasterise each scan with its captured vertex colours from random viewpoints with varying fields of view.
We match foreground colour statistics to real video frames and apply slight Gaussian blur, sensor noise and a JPEG round trip.
Finally, we crop around the head as in the real-image pipeline.
Among several variants of this renderer, this one was closest to real photographs in DINOv3 feature statistics.
blocks.zh:
像素3D-FT是像素3 D在三个几何阶段都进行了微调,带有Eq 1,没有建筑变化.
我们的适配器都接受了同样的训练。
我们用其捕捉到的顶点颜色,用不同视域的随机角度,对每个扫描进行光刻。
我们把前景颜色统计与真实的视频帧相匹配,并应用轻微的高斯模糊,感应噪声和JPEG的往返.
最后,我们用真实的图像管道在头部进行裁剪。
在这种渲染器的几个变体中,这个最接近DINOv3特征统计中的真实照片.

blocks.en: C.3 Adapters and Joint Training
blocks.zh: C.3 适应者和联合培训

blocks.en:
The adapters follow every third block of both flows, starting with the third block.
Each adapter uses LayerNorm, width-512 query, key and value projections with 8 heads, the key embeddings of Eq. 5 , and a learned null key-value pair.
A zero-initialised projection maps back to the backbone width, with its output scaled by a gate on the timestep embedding.
The key embeddings combine a depth MLP, used in both stages, with a validity embedding in S1 and an offset MLP in S2, and every stage has 55 M adapter parameters.
The depth features d i d_{i} and d j d_{j} are the coordinates of the query and the key token along the viewing axis of the view-aligned latent grid of their own frame.
blocks.zh:
适配器跟随两条流的三分之一,从第三块开始.
每个适配器使用LayleNorm,宽度-512查询,键和值预测有8个头,键嵌入Eq. 5,以及一个已学到的无键值对.
一个零初始化的投影地图回溯到主干宽度,其输出在时间步嵌入上以一个门缩放.
密钥嵌入结合了深度MLP,在两个阶段都使用,其有效性嵌入在S1中,抵消MLP在S2中,每个阶段都有55M适配参数.
深度特征 d i d_{i} 和 d j d_{j} 是查询的坐标, 以及沿着它们自己框架的视图- 对应潜在网格的视图轴的密钥符号 。

blocks.en:
Registration groups and fitted groups are drawn with equal probability.
All frames of a group share the flow time, which S1 draws from a logit-normal distribution.
The backbone is fine-tuned together with the adapters, with a learning rate ten times lower than that of the adapters.
blocks.zh:
登记组和配备组的概率相同。
一组的所有帧都分享流线时间,S1从一个对数正常的分布中提取.

blocks.en: C.5 Clean-Up

blocks.en:
The pipeline’s standard mesh clean-up closes small holes, cuts the decoded surface along non-manifold edges and removes connected components below an area threshold.
Removing pieces disconnected from the head by these cuts opens holes, most visibly around the mouth.
Our clean-up applies the same repairs but removes floating components only after re-welding the cut, then fills small loops.
Above the head region’s lower boundary, it closes each remaining boundary loop of perimeter 10–250 mm with a flat ring patch over the hole border.
For real images, the minimum perimeter is 3 mm.
This removes most holes and leaves the geometry metrics essentially unchanged ( Tab. S1 ).
We apply this clean-up to both Head Anything and Pixal3D-FT meshes.
It is not a contribution of this work but makes the meshes usable as hole-free head surfaces.

blocks.en:
For a sequence of real images, as for the FaceVerse renders, all frames are cropped with one square crop around the matte of the first frame, enlarged by 10%.
This crop defines one virtual camera in which every frame is generated.
Its intrinsics come from capture calibration, the FaceVerse render camera or, for in-the-wild images, the focal length predicted by Face Anything [ 19 ] .
Face Anything predicts metric depth and canonical coordinates for each frame, from which we obtain its rigid head motion relative to this camera.
Scaled ray-ICP against the predicted depth then estimates the metric scale of each single-frame mesh.
On NPHM, every frame is generated in its own render camera, and A f A_{f} comes from per-frame FLAME fits.

blocks.en: D.2 Alignment and Metrics
blocks.zh: D.2 对齐和计量

blocks.en:
Every prediction is aligned to its scan using the same similarity search [ 2 , 38 ] .
We run scaled trimmed ICP from 72 starting orientations, using a two-sided residual to prevent scale collapse.
We then run face ICP from each resulting pose, followed by 12 perturbed restarts from the best poses.
We keep the pose with the lowest face residual and finally align the face rigidly, so that the metrics compare shapes rather than placements.
The face and lips regions are defined by a FLAME fit of each scan, and the head region by a plane 2 cm below the chin of that fit.
To measure cross-frame consistency, we move each aligned prediction’s non-face points into every other frame of the same person using the inverse-distance-weighted displacement of the 8 nearest correspondence vertices.
Correspondences come from NPHM registrations or FLAME fits to FaceVerse scans.
We measure the mean distance to each target frame’s aligned non-face surface and average over all target frames.

我们从72个起始方向进行按比例调整的比较方案,利用双侧残基防止规模崩溃。
然后我们从每个姿势开始面对比较方案,然后从最佳姿势开始12次扰动重启。
我们把姿势保留在最低的面部残基上,最后把面部僵硬地对齐,这样衡量标准就可以比较形状而不是位置.
面部和唇部区域由每次扫描的FLAME配位来定义,头部区域由该配位的下巴以下2厘米的平面来定义.
为了衡量跨框架的一致性,我们利用8个最近通信顶点的反距离加权移位,将每个对齐的预测的非面点移到同一人的所有其他框架。

blocks.en:
For silhouette IoU, we fit a per-frame similarity transform to masks from the alignment cameras, including the input cameras, by maximising a differentiable soft-silhouette IoU from 144 starts.
We then measure IoU in held-out cameras within a head region shared by all methods.
For the Chamfer distance, every mesh is aligned to the stereo points of its timestamp with the similarity search above, and only the prediction vertices within 10 mm of a camera-visible stereo point are used.
The cross-view consistency is the head Chamfer distance between the two meshes generated from the two synchronised images of one timestamp, each placed by its own alignment to the stereo points.

然后,我们用所有方法共享的头部区域中被搁置的摄像机测量IoU。

blocks.en: Appendix F Ablations

blocks.en:
All ablations are evaluated on the 80 NPHM frames with the protocol of Tab. 1 , the same test-time fits and the same seeds as Head Anything.
Every variant changes one setting of its reference, and both stages are retrained with otherwise identical settings unless the variant needs no training.
blocks.zh:
在80个NPHM框架上用Tab 1的标语来评估所有淤青,测试时间与Head Anything一样合适,种子也相同.
每一种变体都会改变其参考的设定,两个阶段都经过重新培训,但不同的设置不同,除非变体不需要培训。

blocks.en:
Tab. S4 varies the joint stages, the keys, the training correspondences and the backbone training.
Generating both stages jointly performs best.
Most of the gain comes from joint generation in the structure stage, since S1 determines the occupied voxels and thus the hair volume and back of the head.
Joint generation in the shape stage further improves the result.
Without the depth features or the null key, the overall accuracy is similar, but the lips, the region whose shape changes most between expressions, become less accurate.
Training on the fitted pool alone performs slightly worse than mixed training.
Freezing the backbone also captures slightly less facial detail than fine-tuning it jointly with the adapters.
blocks.zh:
Tab. S4不同联赛阶段,关键环节,训练函授和骨干训练.
两个阶段共同产生效果最好。
所得大部分来自结构阶段的联产,因为S1决定了占用的花瓶,从而决定了头部的发积和背部.
形状阶段的联合生成进一步改善了结果.
没有深度特征或无效键,整体准确度就相似,但唇,其形状在表达方式之间变化最大的区域,其准确度则越来越低.
仅在装配的游泳池上进行的培训比混合培训稍差。
冷冻骨干还捕捉到的面部细节略低于与适配器联合微调.

blocks.en:
Our adapters are trained jointly with the backbone for additional steps.
For comparison, we fine-tune Pixal3D-FT without adapters using the same number of steps, trainer, data, group sizes and images per step, then generate each frame independently ( Tab. S5 ).
The additional fine-tuning does not improve Pixal3D-FT and even slightly reduces its accuracy.
This indicates that our method’s gains come from joint generation rather than additional training.
blocks.zh:
我们的适配器与骨干一起接受额外步骤的培训。
为了进行比较,我们微调了Pixal3D-FT,没有适配器,每步使用相同的步数,教练器,数据,组大小和图像,然后独立生成每个帧(Tab. S5).
附加的微调并不能改善Pixal3D-FT,甚至会略微降低它的精度.
这表明我们的方法来自联合培训而不是额外的培训。

blocks.en: Appendix H Additional Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 附录H 其他定性结果

blocks.en:
Fig. S2 , Fig. S3 , Fig. S4 and Fig. S5 show further results of our method on NeRSemble [ 17 ] , AVA-256 [ 26 ] , VFHQ [ 44 ] and CelebV-HQ [ 48 ] , two identities with four images each.
Our method produces high-quality, detailed head geometry from studio captures and in-the-wild video frames alike.
Every mesh is shown in the head frame from the front, from both sides and from the back, in surface-normal colours. Fig. S6 shows two failure cases with a hand-held microphone in front of the mouth or at the chin.
Our method merges the microphone and head into one surface rather than separating them.
The microphone also overlaps with the mouth and chin.
The rest of the head, including the back, stays plausible and consistent with the input.
